reader_profile: 繁體中文讀者；不預設已懂本專案或模型術語。依實際公布路線閱讀，不能以課外專家常識補作者缺口。
route: 先以游標的supplement讀明列context，再從main頁逐單元讀正文；全main完成前不提前開正文選讀。可回查當前明確連結必要前文，記錄實際路徑；若超出plan先請root擴充。
constraints: No author answer, concept map, expected verdict, historical issues or peer reports before own source original is saved.
No book, figure, code, shared tooling or reading-time edits; no training/model-final/teacher inference/paid compute/publication.
Save original uncertainty and concept observations before opening the next unit; later clarification never rewrites original notes.
